prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 会议室预订周视图（5/12–5/16） (language zh-CN).
Grid: 6 columns × 7 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "2025 春季校园招聘宣讲会（09:00–17:" spans 3 col × 1 row; "产品需求评审（09:00–12:00）｜A301" spans 1 col × 2 row; "新员工入职培训（13:30–16:30）｜C20" spans 1 col × 2 row; "客户方案演示与答疑（13:30–16:30）｜A" spans 1 col × 2 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "时间段" · longest unbreakable word 53px · one-line width 94px
  col 2: header "周一（5/12）" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 261px
  col 3: header "周二（5/13）" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 214px
  col 4: header "周三（5/14）" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 274px
  col 5: header "周四（5/15）" · longest unbreakable word 63px · one-line width 304px
  col 6: header "周五（5/16）" · longest unbreakable word 62px · one-line width 190px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"展示一周内各时段的会议室预订，帮助读者查找活动并比较每天的安排。","reading":"先按左侧时间段定位，再横向查看各天；也可沿某一天纵向浏览。跨列活动表示覆盖多个日期，跨行活动表示持续多个时段。","groups":["第1列是时间索引，需要与各日期列清楚区分。","第2至第6列分别代表周一至周五，作用相同，应保持相近的视觉权重；较长的活动内容可获得适度额外宽度。"],"keep_intact":["时间段和活动中的时间范围","日期、会议室编号及其他标识符","跨行和跨列活动的覆盖关系"],"may_wrap":["活动名称可在自然词界或标点处换行。","活动名称、时间和会议室编号之间可换行。","跨行活动已有的高度可以容纳部分换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [115, 86, 86, 86, 86, 86] · table 546×650px · row heights [60, 60, 106, 129, 83, 106, 106] · column headers wrapped 5/6 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 186px
Design r0B: widths [115, 125, 110, 130, 140, 105] · table 726×534px · row heights [60, 60, 106, 83, 60, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 2/6 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 366px
Design r0C: widths [74, 57, 57, 57, 57, 57] · table 360×1115px · row heights [83, 83, 199, 222, 153, 199, 176] · column headers wrapped 5/6 · tallest cell 11 lines · mid-word splits 19

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"时间段完整且容易扫描；日期列宽度一致，保持了工作日之间的平等关系。没有单词内部拆分，跨行活动也仍可辨认。","problems":"日期标题普遍换行，活动名称和时间被切成较多短行，导致行高不均、纵向比较费力。首屏只能看到前两天及周三的一部分，仍需横向滚动。","cause":"时间列为115px，足以容纳完整时间段；五个日期列各为86px，正文可用宽度仅65px，迫使标题和活动内容频繁换行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"活动内容比r0A舒展，最高单元格只有四行，时间和会议室编号保持完整；较长的周三、周四内容获得了更多空间。","problems":"整表很宽，首屏主要显示时间列和前两天，查看后半周需要较大幅度滚动；日期列宽差异也削弱了各天作为同类栏目的一致节奏。","cause":"日期列为105–140px，总宽达到726px，比视口多366px；周四140px和周三130px虽减少换行，也增加了横向浏览成本。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"整周一次可见，日期之间的对应关系和跨列活动的覆盖范围容易从整体上把握。","problems":"时间范围、日期和会议室编号被拆开，活动名称形成狭窄的字串；行高很大且变化明显，难以沿行比较，也难以快速辨认预约。","cause":"时间列只有74px，日期列各为57px，扣除内边距和边框后正文分别仅有53px和36px；这些宽度不足以容纳时间范围和标识符。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-scroll","widths":[115,100,95,105,105,95],"change":"以r0A为基础适度加宽日期列，优先照顾内容较长的周三、周四，同时保持五天的视觉权重接近；期望减少活动和标题的碎片化换行，并把总宽控制在615px。"},{"name":"readable-week","widths":[115,110,105,115,120,105],"change":"以r0B为基础收窄最宽的日期列，保留周三、周四的适度额外空间；在可读性与横向滚动之间测试更舒展的折中，总宽670px。"},{"name":"compact-scroll","widths":[115,90,90,95,95,90],"change":"保留完整时间索引，将日期列较r0A小幅加宽，并给内容较长的周三、周四各多5px；测试能否以575px总宽改善换行，同时让首屏显示更多日期。"}]}
